_note: v2 theme mapping, 30 Sep 2026. Keys of 'clusters' are the internal cluster ids stored in reviews.db (clusters, centroids, assignments, assignment_log, labels/threshold_labels.csv); 'id' is the display id shown to people. Nothing in reviews.db was changed. kind: complaint = on the complaint dashboard; separate = shown apart, not ranked with complaints; positive = one line with its count; unsorted = clusters found in the bucket awaiting a decision. Clusters found in the bucket later are not in this file until added. assignment_log rows from runs before the latest reset may name 1000+ ids that belonged to since-discarded bucket clusters; those ids do not resolve to the entries below (labels/NOTES.md).
